title: Highland Ridge RV: LED Ceiling Lights may Produce Excessive Heat (3,379 affected)
summary: Highland Ridge RV (Highland Ridge) is recalling certain 2017 Open Range, Highlander, Light and Roamer and Mesa Ridge fifth wheels and Mesa Ridge, Light, Roamer and Ultra Lite travel trailers.  The LED ceiling lights may produce excessive heat.

title: Jayco, Inc.: LED Ceiling Lights may Produce Excessive Heat (13,049 affected)
summary: Jayco Inc. (Jayco) is recalling certain 2017 Jay Flight Bungalow, Hummingbird, White Hawk, Jay Flight SLX, Jay Feather 7, Jay Feather and Jay Flight fifth wheel recreational trailers.  The LED ceiling lights may produce excessive heat.

title: Gulf States Toyota, Inc.: Roof Rack may Loosen and Detach (1,019 affected)
summary: Gulf States Toyota, Inc (Gulf States) is recalling certain 2016-2017 4Runner vehicles equipped with the TFORCE accessory package.  The fasteners for the aftermarket roof rack may have been improperly tightened.

title: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc.: Head Curtain Air Bag Improper Deployment/FMVSS 226 (17,694 affected)
summary: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc. (Volkswagen) is recalling certain 2015-2017 Audi A7 vehicles.  The affected vehicles have head curtain air bags that may not deploy properly in the event of a crash.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 226, "Ejection Mitigation."

title: Shyft Group: Park Brake Actuator Knob Instructions Incorrect (18 affected)
summary: Spartan Motors USA (Spartan) is recalling certain 2008-2017 Gladiator and MetroStar emergency response vehicles equipped with a supplemental park brake system (SPBS).  The directions to activate the SPBS incorrectly state to "Pull" the actuation knob, when it should say "Push."

title: Forest River, Inc.: Improperly Seated Bolt in Axle Hanger (487 affected)
summary: Forest River, Inc. (Forest River) is recalling certain 2014 XLR Hyperlite toyhaulers.  These vehicles have an axle equalizer knurled bolt (axle shackle locating bolt) that may not be properly seated in the chassis axle hanger.

title: Gulf States Toyota, Inc.: Spare Tire Air Pressure may be Incorrect (409 affected)
summary: Gulf States Toyota, Inc. (Gulf States) is recalling certain 2017 4Runner , 86, Avalon, Camry, Camry Hybrid, Corolla, Corolla iM, Highlander, Highlander Hybrid, Prius, Prius C, RAV4, RAV4 Hybrid, Sienna  and Yaris vehicles.  The spare tire air pressure was not adjusted to the proper pressure as stated on the Tire Pressure Label.

title: Prevost Car (US) Inc.: Wiper Arms may Crack and Detach from Vehicle (123 affected)
summary: Prevost Cars, Inc. (Prevost) is recalling certain 2016-2017 H3-45 motor coaches.  The affected vehicles have wiper arms that can crack where they mount to the wiper motor causing the wiper arms to bend or detach from the vehicle.

title: Prevost Car (US) Inc.: Trailer Hitch may Loosen and Detach (407 affected)
summary: Prevost Cars, Inc. (Prevost) is recalling certain 2014-2017 H3-45, H3-45 VIP, X3-45, X3-45 VIP, and X3-45 VIP Entertainer motor coaches equipped with 10,000lb-capacity trailer hitch receivers.  The trailer hitch mounting fasteners may loosen.

title: Prevost Car (US) Inc.: Front Reflectors Missing/FMVSS 108 (71 affected)
summary: Prevost Cars, Inc. (Prevost) is recalling certain 2016-2017 Prevost X3-45 vehicles.  The vehicles were manufactured without the front amber reflex reflectors.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 108, "Lamps, Reflective Devices, and Associated Equipment."

title: Porsche Cars North America, Inc.: Fuel Pump Flange May Crack Causing Fuel Leak (51,497 affected)
summary: Porsche Cars North America, Inc. (Porsche) is recalling certain 2015-2017 Macan S and Macan Turbo vehicles, and 2017 Macan,  Macan Turbo with the Performance Package, and Macan GTS vehicles. The fuel pump flange on the affected vehicles may crack, allowing fuel to leak.

title: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc.: Vehicle may Roll Despite being in 'Park' (5 affected)
summary: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc. (Volkswagen) is recalling certain 2017 Audi Q5 vehicles.  Due to a manufacturing defect within the gearbox, despite selecting the Park position, the vehicle may still unexpectedly roll.

title: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc.: Fuel Pump Flange May Crack Causing Fuel Leak (240,487 affected)
summary: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc. (Volkswagen) is recalling certain model year 2013-2017 Audi Q5 and 2013-2017 Audi Q7 vehicles.  These gasoline-powered vehicles have a fuel pump flange that may crack, allowing fuel to leak.

title: K.Z., Inc.: Possible Propane Gas Leak (113 affected)
summary: KZRV, L.P. (KZRV) is recalling certain 2018 Sport Trek and Durango travel trailers equipped with the outside kitchen option.  The affected travel trailers may not have had the proper sealing tape installed on the propane gas line.  Additionally, the gas line may not have been tested during production.

title: Jim Reed's Truck Sales, Inc.: Incorrect Information on Label/FMVSS 567 (18 affected)
summary: Jim Reed's Truck Sales, Inc. (JRTS) is recalling certain 2014-2016 Hino 338 trucks modified by JRTS.  The affected trucks have Certification labels that do not identify JRTS as the final stage manufacturer.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of 49 CFR Part 567, "Certification."

title: Honda (American Honda Motor Co.): Replacement Engine Assembled with Wrong Pistons (16 affected)
summary: Honda (American Honda Motor Co.) is recalling certain 2015-2016 Honda CR-V vehicles that recently received a replacement engine.  The replacement engine may have been built with the wrong pistons, potentially affecting the engine's performance.

title: Akron Brass Company: Firefighting Nozzles may have Reduced Water Output (108 affected)
summary: Akron Brass Company (ABC) is recalling certain Ultrajet firefighting nozzles, style 1820.  Components within the nozzles may bind, limiting the water output.

title: TRW Automotive, Inc.: Dust Shield may Allow Ball Joint Stud Corrosion (6,086 affected)
summary: TRW Automotive Inc (TRW) is recalling certain aftermarket replacement Left Hand and Right Hand Lower Ball Joints, sold for use on Toyota 4Runner, Sequioa and Tundra vehicles.  These ball joints were built incorrectly with a vented dust shield on the ball joint stud, which could allow contamination to enter the joint, possibly causing wear and looseness.

title: Forest River, Inc.: Incorrect Federal Tire Placard/FMVSS 110 (52 affected)
summary: Forest River, Inc. (Forest River) is recalling certain 2017 XLR ToyHauler trailers, model XLT26HFS.  The Federal Placard incorrectly states that the rear tire pressure should be 50psi, when the tires should actually be inflated to 80psi.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 110, "Tire Selection and Rims."

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): Halfshaft may Disengage/Loss of Drive (4,705 affected)
summary: Chrysler (FCA US LLC) is recalling certain 2017 Jeep Compass vehicles equipped with a 6-speed transmission. The left front halfshaft may not be properly seated, and, as a result, it may disengage from the transmission and/or break.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): Side Curtain Air Bags may not Deploy in a Rollover (1,021,279 affected)
summary: Chrysler (FCA US LLC) is recalling certain model year 2013-2016 Ram 1500, Ram 2500, and 2014-2016 Ram 3500 vehicles.  Certain driving conditions, such as driving off-road or debris striking the vehicle may cause the roll rate sensor to trigger a fault within the Occupant Restraint Controller (ORC).  If this fault occurs, the rollover side curtain air bag and the seat belt pretensioner will be disabled from deploying.

title: General Motors, LLC: Air Bag Deployment may Injure Neck/FMVSS 208 (55,068 affected)
summary: General Motors LLC (GM) is recalling certain 2016-2017 Chevrolet Spark vehicles.  In the event of a crash, if a young child is seated improperly and not wearing a seat belt while in the front passenger seat, deployment of the front passenger air bag may injure the occupant's neck.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 208, "Occupant Crash Protection."

title: Mercedes-Benz USA, LLC: Brakes may Drag and Overheat (5,818 affected)
summary: Mercedes-Benz USA, LLC (MBUSA) is recalling certain 2015 SLK 250, 2016 SLK 350, 2016-2017 SLC 300, and 2017 SLC 43 AMG vehicles.  In these vehicles, the electronic stability control (ESC) system software may incorrectly keep the brakes slightly applied.

title: Norgren Inc.: Suspension may Lower Unexpectedly (1 affected)
summary: Norgren Inc. (Norgren) is recalling one Kneeling Module, part number K990073.  The air valve pistons have retaining snap rings in the manifold that may be improperly seated.

title: Graco Children's Products, Inc.: Child Seat Webbing may Tear Under Load/FMVSS 213 (25,494 affected)
summary: Graco Children's Products Inc. (Graco) is recalling certain Graco My Ride 65 convertible child restraints, models 1871689, 1908152, 1813074, 1872691, 1853478, 1877535, 1813015, and 1794334.  In the event of a crash, the child seat webbing may not adequately restrain the child.  As such, these car seats fail to conform to Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 213, "Child Restraint Systems."

title: Sprague Devices: Wiper Arms may Bend or Detach (1,179 affected)
summary: Sprague Devices (Sprague) is recalling certain Heavy-Duty Bus Pantograph Wiper Arms.  The mounting casting that attaches the wiper arms to the wiper motor may crack, possibly causing the arms to bend or detach.

title: Temsa: Leveling Valve Bracket may detach (167 affected)
summary: Temsa Global Sanayi Ve Ticaret A.S. (Temsa) is recalling certain model year 2014-2017 TEMSA TS 45 motorcoaches.  Improper fasteners were used to attach the leveling valve linkage mechanism.  As a result, the components may loosen and detach.

title: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc.: Heat Shield not Long Enough to Prevent Damage (84,262 affected)
summary: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc. (Volkswagen) is recalling certain 2012-2014 Passat vehicles, equipped with diesel engines and Direct-Shift Transmissions (DSG).  The vehicle's underbody heat shield may not be long enough to protect the right half-shaft grease boot from heat, potentially resulting in a grease leak.

title: Southeast Toyota Distributors, LLC: Defective Lugnuts May Crack or Detach (1,325 affected)
summary: Southeast Toyota Distributors, LLC (SET) is recalling certain model year 2013-2017 Toyota Tundra and Sequoia vehicles accessorized with Southeast Toyota accessory 20-inch Rockstar wheels installed by Southeast Toyota or a Southeast Toyota dealer.  The Rockstar wheels were installed with lugnuts that may crack and detach.

title: Daimler Trucks North America, LLC: Seat Mounting Reinforcement Brackets Missing (22 affected)
summary: Daimler Trucks North America LLC (DTNA) is recalling certain 2016-2018 Thomas Built Buses Minotour DRW school buses.  The occupant seats may have been installed without reinforcement brackets being used underneath the seat rail as intended.

title: Daimler Trucks North America, LLC: Seats Installed without Under-Rail Washers (1,132 affected)
summary: Daimler Trucks North America LLC (DTNA) is recalling certain 2014-2018 Thomas Built Buses Saf-T-Liner EFX and Saf-T-Liner HDX school buses. The occupant seats may have been installed without under-rail washers, reducing their anchorage strength.

title: Daimler Trucks North America, LLC: Improperly Anchored Seat Lap Belt (46 affected)
summary: Daimler Trucks North America LLC (DTNA) is recalling certain 2013-2018 Thomas Built Saf-T-Liner HDX transit buses.  The occupant seat lap belts may have been anchored to the seat instead of the bus structure.

title: Daimler Trucks North America, LLC: Tandem Axle Output Shaft may Fracture (698 affected)
summary: Daimler Trucks North America LLC (DTNA) is recalling certain 2017 Freightliner Cascadia and Western Star 5700 trucks built with NFD tandem rear axles.  During the hardening process, the axle assembly output shaft may have been made brittle, possibly resulting in the output shaft fracturing while the vehicle is in use.

title: Daimler Trucks North America, LLC: Improperly Anchored Seat Lap Belt (152 affected)
summary: Daimler Trucks North America LLC (DTNA) is recalling certain 2013-2018 Thomas Built Saf-T-Liner HDX school buses.  The occupant seat lap belts may have been anchored to the seat instead of the bus structure.

title: Keystone RV Company: Tires may Contact Outriggers (39 affected)
summary: Keystone RV Company (Keystone) is recalling certain 2017-2018 Raptor fifth-wheel recreational trailers, model 428SP.  The affected trailers have tires that may contact the outriggers.

title: Bombardier Recreational Products, Inc.: Low Beam may Shine Too High/FMVSS 108 (94 affected)
summary: Bombardier Recreational Products Inc. (BRP) is recalling certain 2017 Can Am Spyder RT motorcycles.  Due to a manufacturing error within the headlight assembly, the headlight may shine too high when on the low beam setting.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 108, "Lamps, Reflective Devices, and associated Equipment."

title: Forest River, Inc.: Incorrect Federal Placards/FMVSS 110 (9 affected)
summary: Forest River, Inc. (Forest River) is recalling certain 2018 Palomino recreational trailers, model PAT251RBSS.  The Federal Placard does not list the correct tire size, tire pressure, and rim size information of ST205/75R14C tires requiring 50 PSI and a rim size of 14X5.5JJ.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 110, "Tire Selection and Rims."

title: Hickory Springs Manufacturing Company: Covers may Prevent Seat-Mounted Airbag Deployment (29 affected)
summary: Hickory Springs Manufacturing Company (HSM) is recalling certain Summit-brand driver and front passenger seat accessory seat covers sold for use in RAM ProMaster, Ford Transit and Mercedes Sprinter vehicles.  The outside edge seam of the seat cover may not open up as designed, possibly affecting the deployment of the seat-mounted air bags in the event of a crash.

title: Terex South Dakota, Inc.: GFCI may not Protect User against Shock (58 affected)
summary: Terex South Dakota (TSD) is recalling certain 2007-2016 vehicles equipped with Terex C4000, FC, HR, HRX, SCM, TC, TCX, TL, TPL, and XT aerial devices and digger derricks used for utility line work.  In the event of a short circuit of a tool plugged into the onboard electrical socket, the GFPE breaker may not trip at the proper current before the user receives a shock.

title: Terex South Dakota, Inc.: Loss of Remote Control Functions (444 affected)
summary: Terex South Dakota (TSD) is recalling certain 2012-2017 Digger Derricks and Aerial Devices, models C4000, C5000, C6000, C7000, General, HR, OM, RM,RMX, SC, SCM, TC, TCX, TL, TM, and XT, built on Freightliner chassis with SmartPlex engine controls.  The vehicles have a switch to monitor whether the hood is open or not.  If the switch thinks that the hood is open, the vehicle software may disable the Aerial or Digger Derrick remote engine control functions.

title: Daytona Helmets International: Helmet may not Protect from Impact/FMVSS 218 (2,454 affected)
summary: Daytona Helmets International (Daytona) is recalling certain Skull Cap D1, D3 and D6 Helmets in sizes 3XS through 4XL manufactured during May 2015.  These helmets may not adequately protect the wearer in the event of a head impact during a motorcycle crash.  As such, these helmets fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 218, "Motorcycle Helmets."

title: PACCAR Incorporated: Brake Control Airline is Incorrect Size/FMVSS 121 (23 affected)
summary: PACCAR Incorporated (PACCAR) is recalling certain 2012-2018 Kenworth T800 and T880 vehicles equipped with Neway ADZ tridem rear suspensions.  The brake control airline may be the incorrect size, resulting in an imbalance in the service brake application timing.   As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 121, "Air brake systems."

title: Nova Bus (US) Inc.: Full Throttle Application from Communication Loss (24 affected)
summary: Nova Bus (Nova) is recalling certain 2016 Nova LFS Artic transit buses.  In the event of a loss of communication within the bus' multiplex network, the computer may command full throttle application, without input from the driver.

title: Isuzu Motors Limited: Throttle may Stick in the Open Position (14,807 affected)
summary: Isuzu Technical Center of America, Inc. (Isuzu) is recalling certain model year 2008-2009 and 2012-2013 Isuzu NPR and NPR HD vehicles and 2008-2009 GMC W3500 and GMC W4500 vehicles.  The affected vehicles, equipped with a gasoline-powered engine, have a throttle pedal that may get stuck under the steel stopper bolt, causing the pedal to remain in the full throttle position.

title: Bison Coach, LLC: Incorrect GAWR on Label/FMVSS 567 (192 affected)
summary: Bison Coach, LLC (Bison) is recalling certain model year 2016-2018 Bison Horse Trailers, models Laredo, Premiere, Ranger, Silverado, Trail Boss and Trail Hand.  These trailers contain incorrect Gross Axle Weight Rating (GAWR) information on the Certification label.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of 49 CFR Part 567, "Certification."

title: Ferrara Fire Apparatus, Inc.: Movable Ladder Guardrail may Bend or Break (61 affected)
summary: Ferrara Fire Apparatus, Inc. (Ferrara) is recalling certain 2000-2016 Fire Apparatus 100' Rear Mount Platform emergency vehicles. The affected vehicles are equipped with a movable ladder access guardrail that may bend or break under heavy loads.

title: BMW of North America, LLC: Incorrect Tire Information Label/FMVSS110 (24 affected)
summary: BMW North America, LLC (BMW) is recalling certain 2017 BMW X5 M and BMW X6 M vehicles.  The vehicles are equipped with 21-inch tires, however the Tire Information Label states that the vehicles are equipped with 20-inch tires.  As such, these vehicles fail to conform to Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 110, "Tire Selection and Rims."

title: BMW of North America, LLC: Doors May Not Fully Latch (45,484 affected)
summary: BMW of North America, LLC (BMW) is recalling certain 2005-2008 745i, 745Li, 750i, 750Li, 760i, 760Li, and B7 Alpina vehicles equipped with both the Comfort Access and Soft Close Automatic options.   In these vehicles, the doors may appear to be closed and latched, but, in fact, may inadvertently open.

title: Daimler Coaches North America: Exterior Covers may Detach (5 affected)
summary: Setra of North America (Setra) is recalling certain 2017 Setra S407CC motor coaches.  The vehicle's exterior covers which are bonded to powder coated frames may detach from the vehicle because the powder coating may peel off of the frame.

title: Columbia Northwest, Inc.: LP Gas Bottle Trays Attached with Wrong Fasteners (40 affected)
summary: Columbia Northwest, Inc. (Columbia Northwest) is recalling certain 2017-2018 Aliner Ascape trailers. The trailers have liquid propane (LP) gas bottle trays that come loose from the frames due to the wrong rivets being used to attach the LP tray to the frame.

title: Ford Motor Company: Door may Unlatch in a Side Impact Collision (14,410 affected)
summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2015-2017 F-150, and 2017 F-250, F-350, F-450, and F-550 vehicles originally produced with black or body colored exterior door handles that may have been subsequently equipped with a chrome exterior door handle cover accessory kit purchased from a Ford dealer.  These accessory door handle covers may cause the doors to unlatch in a side impact collision.  As such, these vehicles may fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 206, "Door Locks and Door Retention Components."

title: Ford Motor Company: Driver Seat Back Frame May Fail/FMVSS 202, 207 (2,204 affected)
summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2017 Ford Explorer, F-150, F-250, F-350, F-450 and F-550 vehicles equipped with a manual driver's seat back recliner mechanism.  In the event of a crash, the seat back frame may not restrain the occupant due to having inadequate welds.  As such, these vehicles may not meet the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) numbers 202a, "Head Restraints" and 207, "Seating Systems."

title: Harley-Davidson Motor Company: Engine Oil Cooler Line Clamp Incorrectly Installed (45,589 affected)
summary: Harley-Davidson Motor Company (Harley-Davidson) is recalling certain 2017 Electric Glide Ultra Classic (FLHTCU), Police Electra Glide (FLHTP), Police Road King (FLHP), Road King (FLHR), Road King Special (FLHRXS), Street Glide (FLHX), Street Glide Special (FLHXS), Road Glide (FLTRX), and Road Glide Special (FLTRXS) motorcycles.  In the affected motorcycles, a clamp used to secure an engine oil cooler line may have been improperly installed.

title: American Kenda Rubber Industrial Company: Void in Tire may cause Tread Separation (696 affected)
summary: American Kenda Rubber Industrial (Kenda) is recalling certain Kenda Kenetica tires, size P235/75R15 105S KR17.  The tires may have a void between the top steel belt and the tire undertread located at the overlapped steel belt splice.

title: REV Ambulance Group Orlando, Inc.: Cot System Securing Hardware may be too Short (24 affected)
summary: REV Ambulance Group Orlando, Inc. (REV) is recalling certain model year 2012-2013 Road Rescue Type I, 2013-2016 Road Rescue Type III, and 2014-2017 Road Rescue Type IX emergency vehicles equipped with a 2" subfloor.  The bolts used to install the cot securing system to the floor may be too short.

title: Keystone RV Company: Fuel Line Improperly Clamped to the Generator (249 affected)
summary: Keystone RV Company (Keystone) is recalling certain 2017-2018 Dutchmen Voltage trailers equipped with the Onan 5.5 generator option.  The fuel line may have been clamped incorrectly to the generator.

title: Forest River, Inc.: Incorrect GAWR on Federal Placard/Part 567 (17 affected)
summary: Forest River, Inc. (Forest River) is recalling certain 2016-2018 Cardinal recreational trailers, model CAF3250RL.  The Federal Placard on these vehicles overstates the Gross Axle Weight Rating capacity (GAWR) by 840lbs. for each axle.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of 49 CFR Part 567, "Certification."

title: Motor Coach Industries, Inc: Exhaust Bellow Pipe may be Incorrectly Installed (143 affected)
summary: Motor Coach Industries (MCI) is recalling certain 2011-2012 MCI D4000, D4005, D4500 and D4505 coaches equipped with Cummins ISX 12 liter engines.  The vehicles may have an incorrectly installed exhaust bellow pipe, resulting in a bend in the pipe which can cause its premature failure.

title: Daimler Trucks North America, LLC: Airline Hose and Engine Block Heater Wire may Melt (736 affected)
summary: Daimler Trucks North America LLC (DTNA) is recalling certain 2013-2018 Freightliner Custom Chassis S2G Chassis trucks.  The vehicles have an airline hose and the engine block coolant heater wire that may not have been properly routed and secured during production.

title: Keystone RV Company: Incorrect GAWR on Federal Identification/Part 567 (464 affected)
summary: Keystone RV Company (Keystone) is recalling certain 2012-2018 Springdale recreational vehicles, model 303BH.  The Federal Identification Tag on these vehicles overstate the Gross Axle Weight Rating capacity (GAWR) by 800lbs for each axle.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of 49 CFR Part 567, "Certification."

title: Sumitomo Rubber USA, LLC: Air Pockets in the Shoulder Region of the tires (478 affected)
summary: Sumitomo Rubber USA, LLC (Sumitomo) is recalling certain models of Dunlop Sportmax Q3+ motorcycle tires, size 120/70ZR17 58W.  The affected tires may have porosity (air pockets) in the shoulder region of the tire.  As such, these tires fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 119, "New Pneumatic Tires-Other Than Passenger Cars."

title: Eldorado Mobility, Inc.: Trailing Arm Mounts may Break (413 affected)
summary: ElDorado Mobility (ElDorado Mobility) is recalling certain 2017 Amerivan 10" lowered-floor vehicles.  The vehicles have left and right trailing arm mounts that may break.

title: Jaguar Land Rover North America, LLC: No Warning if Front Turn Signals Fail/FMVSS 108 (19 affected)
summary: Jaguar Land Rover North America, LLC (Jaguar) is recalling certain 2018 Jaguar F-TYPE vehicles equipped with Highline headlamps.  If a front turn signal indicator stops working, the visual and audible turn signal reminders do not flash or chime faster as required.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 108, "Lamps, reflective devices, and associated equipment."

title: Vantage Mobility: Rear Brakes Possibly Crossed During Assembly (371 affected)
summary: Vantage Mobility International, LLC (Vantage Mobility) is recalling certain 2017 Chrysler Pacifica lowered floor vans modified by Vantage Mobility for wheelchair accessibility.  The affected vans have rear brake lines that might have been crossed during the modification.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 135, "Light Vehicle Brake Systems."

title: Gulf Stream Coach, Inc.: Incorrect Axle Capacity Information/Part 567 (7 affected)
summary: Gulf Stream Coach, Inc. (Gulf Stream) is recalling certain 2018 Vintage Cruiser travel trailers, model VN23BHS.  The Federal Certification Label overstates the capacity of each axle by 700lbs.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of 49 CFR Part 567, "Certification."

title: Gulf Stream Coach, Inc.: Incorrect Tire information on Label/FMVSS 567 (272 affected)
summary: Gulf Stream Coach, Inc. (Gulf Stream) is recalling certain 2015-2017 Vista Cruisers and 2016-2018 Vintage Cruiser travel trailers.  The Tire Identification Label incorrectly states that the trailers are equipped with ST215/75R 14 Load Range C rated tires when actually they have ST205/65R 14 Load Range D rated tires.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 567, "Certification."

title: VLRV, LLC (Vanleigh RV): Spare Tire Assembly may Detach from Trailer (815 affected)
summary: VanLeigh RV (VanLeigh) is recalling certain 2015-2018 Vilano fifth-wheel recreational trailers.  Because the winch that supports the spare tire may not be properly fastened to the trailer, the trailer's spare tire could fall off while unit is in motion.

title: Forest River, Inc.: Incorrect Tire Size on Federal Placard/FMVSS 110 (11 affected)
summary: Forest River, Inc. (Forest River) is recalling certain 2016-2017 Vibe recreational trailers, model ORVBT236RBS-64.  The Federal Placard has incorrect rear tire information, indicating ST205/75R15C tires inflated to 50psi, when the actual tires are size ST225/75R15D inflated to 65psi.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 110, "Tire Selection and Rims."

title: K.Z., Inc.: Rubber Gas Hose Connected to Pilot Light (41 affected)
summary: KZRV, L.P. (KZRV) is recalling certain 2016-2018 Venom fifth-wheel travel trailers, models 4040DQ and 4011QK, equipped with the outside kitchen option.  The affected vehicles do not have a 12" copper pipe between the rubber gas supply hose and the cooktop pilot light.

title: Pierce Manufacturing: Rear Steer Axle Shaft not Properly Heat Treated (225 affected)
summary: Pierce Manufacturing (Pierce) is recalling certain 1999-2013 Arrow XT, Dash, Enforcer, Quantum and Velocity fire trucks equipped with the electric All-steer rear steering option.  The affected vehicles have rear steer axle shafts that were not properly heat treated.

title: Jayco, Inc.: Incorrect GAWR Information on Label/FMVSS 110 (88 affected)
summary: Jayco, Inc. (Jayco) is recalling certain 2018 Eagle TT 330RSTS (EA) recreational trailers.  The Federal Placard on these vehicles incorrectly lists the Gross Axle Weight Rating capacity (GAWR) as 5,800lbs, when the axles actually have a capacity of 5,660lbs.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 110, "Tire Selection and Rims."

title: Pierce Manufacturing: Improperly Torqued Sway Bar Fasteners (29 affected)
summary: Pierce Manufacturing (Pierce) is recalling certain 2012-2017 Arrow XT, Dash, Enforcer, Quantum, and Velocity fire trucks equipped with the T3 rear steer option.  The affected vehicles have a rear sway bar that may detach from the vehicle.

title: Shyft Group: Starter may Overheat (721 affected)
summary: Spartan Motors USA (Spartan) is recalling certain 2010-2014 K2 and K3 motor home chassis and Gladiator emergency response chassis cabs.  A component within the starter motor may break, potentially resulting in the starter motor overheating or drawing excessive current.

title: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc.: Mismatched Vehicle Identification Number/FMVSS 567 (2 affected)
summary: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc. (Volkswagen) is recalling certain 2017 Jetta vehicles.  The affected vehicles have Vehicle Identification Number (VIN) markings on the body that do not match the VIN plate near the windshield.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of 49 CFR Part 567, "Certification."

title: Terex Advance Mixer, Inc.: Water Tank Filler Neck Seam may Burst (53 affected)
summary: Terex Advance Mixer, Inc. (Terex) is recalling certain 2017 Front Discharge Mixers, equipped with certain 250 gallon water tanks.  The welds that attach the filler neck onto the 250 gallon pressurized water tank may fail.

title: Honeywell International Recalls SWIFT® Wireless Gateway Sold with Fire Alarm Systems Due To Failure to Communicate in Fire
summary: The smoke detectors connected to the gateway can fail to activate properly when significant environmental contaminants are present, posing a risk that consumers will not be alerted to a fire. Units: About 900.

title: Little Passports Recalls Science Kits Due to Burn Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The battery packs included in the science kits can overheat, posing a burn hazard to consumers. Units: About 7,000 (in addition, 700 were sold in Canada).

title: Carrier and Bryant Recall Heat Pumps Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The capacitors in the fuse boards in the heat pumps can stop working causing the unit to overheat, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 23,300 (In addition about 2,000 sold in Canada).

title: Nature’s Truth Recalls Iron Supplement Bottles Due to Failure to Meet Child-Resistant Closure Requirement
summary: The packaging is not child-resistant as required by the Poison Prevention Packaging Act. The tablets inside the bottle contain iron, which can cause serious injury or death to young children if multiple tablets are ingested at once. Units: About 520.

title: Night Lights Recalled by AM Conservation Group Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The night lights can overheat, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 37,000.

title: Profile Design Recalls Bicycle Handlebar Stems Due to Loss of Control and Crash Hazard
summary: The bicycle handlebar stems can corrode and break, causing the rider to lose control and crash. Units: About 9,700 in the U.S. (135 were sold in Canada).

title: Recreational Off-Highway Vehicles Recalled by American Honda Due to Risk of Injury (Recall Alert)
summary: The front passenger seat belt buckle can fail due to a manufacturing defect, posing a risk of injury. Units: About 2,200.

title: Snowmobiles Recalled by Polaris Due to Crash Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: A weld on the steering post can separate, resulting in loss of steering control, posing a crash hazard. Units: About 6,000.

title: Segway Reannounces Recall of Off-Board Chargers for Segway Personal Transporters Due to Shock Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: A wire inside the charger can detach and touch the side of the charger, posing a shock hazard. Units: About 24 (in addition, 17 were previously recalled in September 2015).

title: Springs Window Fashions Recalls Lithium Batteries Sold with Motorized Window Coverings Due to Fire and Burn Hazards (Recall Alert)
summary: The lithium batteries that power the motorized window coverings can overheat, leak or discharge, posing fire and burn hazards. Units: About 59,100 in the U.S. (in addition, about 2,100 were sold in Canada).

title: Women's Scarves Recalled by DGFA Due to Violation of Federal Flammability Standard; Sold Exclusively on Amazon.com (Recall Alert)
summary: The women's scarves fail to meet federal flammability standard for clothing textiles, posing a risk of burn injuries to consumers. Units: About 200.

title: Combi USA Recalls Stroller and Car Seat Combos Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The car seat can disengage from the stroller's frame, posing a fall hazard to infants. Units: About 1,000.

title: Goodman Recalls Furnaces Due to Electrical Shock Hazard
summary: The blower motor is not grounded, posing an electrical shock hazard to individuals servicing the units Units: About 4,100.

title: HoMedics Recalls Massagers Due to Electric Shock and Burn Hazards
summary: The cord can break near the base of the massager and expose the wires, posing an electric shock and burn hazards. Units: About 400,000.

title: Cordless Electric Lawn Mowers Recalled Due to Fire Hazard; Made by Hongkong Sun Rise Trading
summary: The circuit board in the lawn mower can short circuit and catch fire, posing a fire hazard to users. Units: About 28,000.

title: Extech Recalls Digital Clamp Meters Due to Electrocution Hazard
summary: The meters can fail to give an accurate voltage reading, resulting in the operator falsely believing the electrical power is low or off, posing an electrocution hazard. Units: 1,700 (in addition, about 20 were sold in Canada).

title: Office Chairs Recalled by Leggett & Platt Office Components Due to Fall Hazard
summary: Seat slider bolts and push nuts can disconnect and fall from the chair, which could cause the seat to detach from the chair, posing a fall hazard to consumers. Units: About 47,900 in the U.S. (in addition, about 1,000 in Canada).

title: Williams-Sonoma Recalls Rejuvenation Wall Sconces Due to Shock Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The joint of the articulating arm can pinch or cut the electrical wire causing it to fray, posing a shock hazard. Units: About 1,055.

title: Dynacraft Recalls Ride-On Toys Due to Fall and Crash Hazards
summary: The acceleration pedal on the ride-on toys can stick, posing fall and crash hazards. Units: About 20,000.

title: Hobby Lobby Recalls Easter and July 4th Light-Up Spinner Toys Due to Choking and Ingestion Hazards
summary: The battery cover can detach and expose the small coin cell batteries, posing choking and ingestion hazards to young children. Units: About 43,400.

title: Pier 1 Imports Recalls Temani Wicker Furniture Due to Violation of Federal Lead Paint Standard
summary: The paint used on the wicker furniture can contain excessive levels of lead, which is a violation of the federal lead paint standard. Units: About 2,500 (in addition, about 75 units sold in Canada).

title: Sportex Recalls Rock Salt Lamps Due to Shock and Fire Hazards
summary: The dimmer switch and/or outlet plug can overheat and ignite, posing shock and fire hazards. Units: About 3,900 (80,000 lamps were previously recalled in January 2017).

title: Following Plumber's Death, Electric Ranges Recalled by Arçelik A.S. Due to Shock and Electrocution Hazards
summary: The electric ranges can become energized, posing electric shock and electrocution hazards to a consumer who touches the range Units: About 6,300.

title: Pulse Performance Products Recalls Krusher Scooters Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The down tube can break, posing a fall hazard to the rider. Units: About 18,700.

title: Michaels Recalls Ceramic Travel Mugs Due to Burn Hazard
summary: The mug's lid does not fit securely and can cause liquids to leak from the bottom of the lid when tilted, posing a burn hazard. Also, the mug does not have a silicone hand wrap so the consumer could burn their hand on the side walls of the mug. Units: About 27,000.

title: Pier 1 Imports Recalls Chalk Note Mugs Due to Burn Hazard
summary: The mugs can crack when filled with hot liquid, posing a burn hazard to users. Units: About 15,300 (in addition, about 900 were sold in Canada).

title: Cabrinha Recalls Kiteboard Control Systems Due to Injury and Fall Hazards
summary: The point of connection between the lower front line with the landing line can break, causing a loss of kite control, posing injury and fall hazards. Units: About 2,900.

title: Douglas Recalls Plush Toys Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The plastic eyes on the plush toys can detach, posing a choking hazard. Units: About 25,000.

title: Bradshaw International Recalls Coffee Presses Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: The glass beakers can break during normal use, posing a laceration hazard to users. Units: About 85,000 (in addition, 300 were sold in Canada).

title: VanMoof Recalls Bicycles Due to Fall and Impact Hazards
summary: The front fender bolts do not break when an object gets stuck between the front tire and the front fender/mud guard, posing fall and impact hazards. Units: 375.
